Job Description The Hansestadt Buxtehude is an especially attractive employer for individuals who want to initiate change. Working in our municipal administration is truly unique: highly personal, open-minded, and diverse. Here, your ideas are essential in shaping our city’s present and future in a sustainable way. We are looking for you, effective immediately, in full-time (part-time possible upon request) as: GIS Specialist / Geospatial Data Manager (m/f/d) for the Department of Urban and Landscape Planning. What We Offer A trusting work culture based on respect and tolerance. Space to develop and shape your work independently. Support for your professional and personal growth. Flexible working time models and mobile working options tailored to your life stage. Health promotion initiatives to support your physical and mental well-being. Permanent employment. Fair compensation: salary up to EG 10 TVöD, plus annual bonus, company pension scheme, and performance-based pay. Who We Are? Dive into Saur! (https://www.saur.com/fr/groupe-saur/plongez-dans-saur/) Saur, a major player in water management in France, supports local authorities and industrial clients in the sustainable management of water resources. Present nationwide, the Group relies on local teams to ensure an essential daily service, driven by a strong ambition: 💧 Restoring water to its rightful value.* YOUR DAILY LIFE AT SAUR You will join a committed team responsible for managing and improving the quality of heritage data for water and wastewater networks. As a GIS Technician, you will report to the Operations Director and be responsible for updating, exploiting, and valorizing the geospatial data of the networks. You will also contribute to processing and tracking work declarations (DICT). In this role, you will actively support the quality of heritage data and the performance of operational activities. YOUR MISSIONS Your responsibilities will include: Entering new network infrastructure into the Geographic Information System (GIS); Entering service connections and their characteristics; Integrating detailed drawings and as-built plans; Updating network plans and the heritage database; Creating and updating schematic diagrams; Entering network management data (leaks, cleaning, interventions, etc.); Preparing thematic maps to meet operational needs; Producing cartographic outputs required for operational activities; Generating and printing maps; Performing basic GIS tool maintenance; Producing contractual reports related to network heritage. YOUR PROFILE Diplomas / Qualifications: Minimum Bac+2 (Associate’s degree) in geomatics or equivalent. Experience: At least 3 years of experience in a similar position. Technical Skills: Solid knowledge of drafting and cartographic standards (scales, formats, georeferencing); Proficiency in office software and CAD tools; General knowledge of hydraulics and ability to read water supply and wastewater network plans; Competence in field survey techniques (topography, triangulation, GPS, etc.). You: You demonstrate project management and stakeholder coordination skills. Detail-oriented and organized, you can efficiently plan your workload and prioritize tasks. Comfortable with technical documentation, you ensure its proper management and tracking. You also possess strong analytical skills and the ability to identify and resolve issues effectively. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION Valid driver’s license (Category B) required. Location: Versailles (78). Regular travel within the Yvelines department (78), 1–3 times per week. YOUR SALARY & BENEFITS AT SAUR You will join Saur without any probationary period. Your fixed salary will consist of: A base salary between €26,400 and €31,400, depending on your profile, paid over 13.3 months; A fixed annual bonus of €400 gross, called the Water Sector Bonus*. You may also receive variable compensation: Bonuses/allowances based on activities (on-call duty, travel, night work, etc.); Profit-sharing and performance-based bonuses, depending on company results. You will benefit from social coverage funded by more than 50% by the company: Health insurance (top-up coverage for healthcare expenses beyond Social Security); Life and disability insurance (income protection in case of health-related difficulties). You can build savings through the Group Savings Plan and the Collective Retirement Savings Plan (PERECO), with an employer contribution of up to €960 gross per year. You will also receive 25 days of paid annual leave, plus approximately 14 additional RTT days (statutory reduced-working-time days) per year, depending on annual calendar variations. Joining Saur means joining a Group that offers exciting and rewarding career development opportunities. The #missionwater awaits you! OUR COMMITMENT As an inclusive employer, Saur promotes diversity and welcomes all applications regardless of background, provided skills are equivalent. Saur also places ethics at the heart of its values, emphasizing integrity and transparency in all activities. Join us to contribute to a work environment where ethical principles guide every decision and action.

jobs.description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.

Your impact

When it comes to environmental consulting, we’re focused on cleaning up our communities today to improve tomorrow. We’re seeking an Environmental Compliance Consultant to perform onsite permitting, monitoring, inspections, and other compliance tasks. You’ll contribute your experience and knowledge to our S&EHS Compliance team.

Based out of our Houston office, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with local and global experts to ensure Jacobs provides best practice solutions. You’ll prepare and deliver high-quality reports and presentations to clients’ technical and senior leadership in accordance with Jacobs’ quality process. Apply your technical experience to develop delivery strategies and develop client relationships while championing safety, quality, and the well-being of your team.

In this position, you will develop your understanding of and promote Jacobs’ solutions and technologies to internal and external stakeholders.

This position may require daily travel to a local client site and other occasional travel to team workshops, presentations, or to conduct site visits. Bring your expertise in Environmental Compliance and desire to work on tough problems, and we’ll empower you to deliver the boldest solutions for our clients.

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations, enabling them to deliver their best work when permitted with client contracts.

Here's what you'll need

Bachelor’s degree in environmental, civil, chemical, or a closely related engineering/technical discipline.
Minimum seven years of professional experience in Texas air quality programs, including Title V and NSR permitting, monitoring, reporting, regulatory applicability analyses, and environmental compliance.
Strong knowledge of Texas and federal environmental regulations, with experience supporting operational compliance at industrial facilities.
Experience serving as a primary client-facing technical resource, managing client relationships, and communicating effectively with clients, contractors, and project teams through strong verbal, written, and technical reporting skills.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, lead projects with limited oversight, direct and mentor staff, and apply strong organizational, interpersonal, and analytical skills.
Understanding of industrial manufacturing and process operations, including direct experience with refineries or petrochemical facilities and the compliance implications of refinery processes.
Professional Engineer (PE) license or ability to obtain licensure within one year of employment.
Ability to work on local client sites daily and travel up to 50%.
U.S. citizen.

Ideally, you’ll also have

Master’s degree in environmental, civil, chemical, or a closely related engineering/technical discipline.
Environmental consulting experience with demonstrated expertise in multimedia environmental compliance, including RCRA, SPCC, stormwater permitting and SWPPP development, TRI/Tier II reporting, LDAR programs, environmental auditing and gap analyses, and compliance management system implementation (e.g., Enhesa).
Experience interpreting stack testing and air dispersion modeling results and applying findings to permitting, reporting, and compliance strategies.
Experience supporting environmental compliance and permitting for industrial operations, including chemical and pharmaceutical manufacturing, foundries and metals facilities, smelters, airports, and capital projects from permitting through operations.
Demonstrated ability to mentor staff and effectively engage with stakeholders through public meetings, community relations, and stakeholder outreach activities.

Our health and welfare benefits are designed to invest in you, and in the things you care about. Your health. Your well-being. Your security. Your future. Employees have access to medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance, a 401(k) plan, and the ability to purchase company stock at a discount. Eligible employees may also enroll in a deferred compensation plan or the Executive Deferral Plan. Jacobs has an unlimited U.S. Personalized Paid Time Off (PPTO) policy for full-time salaried/exempt employees, seven paid holidays, and caregiver leave. And certain roles may be eligible for additional rewards, including merit increases, performance discretionary bonus, and stock.

The base salary range for this position is $91,400.00 to $136,000.00. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. Job posted on July 14, 2026. This position will be open for at least 3 days.

At Jacobs, we’re partnering across the globe to create the best project outcomes by maximizing the design, digital technology, and support capabilities of our Global Integrated Delivery (GID) teammates. By joining Jacobs, you’ll commit to supporting and engaging with these teams, as we work to build a company like no other.

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.

Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. Position Summary:

The School Of Engineering & Technology At Central Michigan University Invites Applicants For a Tenure-track Assistant Professor Position To Support The Environmental Engineering Program. The Start Date For This Position Is August 2027. We Seek a Colleague With Expertise In Any Aspect Of Environmental Engineering, But Preference Will Be Given To Candidates With Backgrounds In One Of The Following Areas

Environmental remediation
Solid and hazardous waste engineering
Molecular biology techniques for environmental engineering (e.g., qPCR, metagenomics, etc.)
Air pollution engineering

The selected candidate is expected to teach undergraduate and graduate courses and laboratories, develop an externally funded research program, advise students in research and capstone design projects, and contribute service to benefit the program, School, College, University, profession, and surrounding community. The selected candidate will teach required and elective courses in the Environmental Engineering program but may also teach general engineering and engineering technology courses (depending on specific expertise) that support all programs within the School.

Required Qualifications

Ph.D. in Environmental Engineering, Ecological Engineering, Civil Engineering, Chemical Engineering or a related field. Candidates with a Ph.D. in a related, non-engineering field must have an undergraduate engineering degree in one of the disciplines listed above to be considered for this position. Exceptional ABD candidates will be considered if their degree is completed by the start of the appointment.
Potential for outstanding teaching at the undergraduate and graduate levels and the ability to teach core and elective courses offered within the School.
Demonstrated record of quality research and ability to develop a rigorous scholarship program that involves students.
Strong commitment to research that attracts external funding and leads to publications in competitive peer-reviewed journals.
Commitment to student success and fostering a supportive environment for every member of our university community.
Excellent oral and written communication skills.
Ability to perform the essential functions of the job with or without reasonable accommodation.

Preferred Qualifications

Demonstrated record of effective teaching as the lead instructor.
Demonstrated record of securing external funding.
Postdoctoral experience (academic or industry).
Experience integrating high impact teaching practices (e.g., active learning, project-based learning) into the classroom.
Professional engineering licensure, or possibility of obtaining licensure in the near future.
Relevant industrial or government experience.
Background in environmental remediation, solid and hazardous waste engineering, molecular biology techniques for environmental engineering (e.g., qPCR, metagenomics, etc.), or air pollution engineering.

Message To Applicants

You must submit an online application in order to be considered as an applicant for this position.

Please Submit The Following Materials

cover letter (2 page max)
CV
statement of teaching philosophy (2 page max)
statement of research (2 page max)
contact information for 3 professional references

Cover letters may be addressed to the Hiring Committee.

Position is open until filled, although priority consideration will be given to applications completed by October 19, 2026.

About The Department

The School of Engineering and Technology
(SET) is housed in the College of Science and Engineering
(CSE). SET has four undergraduate Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Computer, and Environmental Engineering), three undergraduate Engineering Technology (Industrial, Mechanical, and Product Design Engineering Technology) and a graduate (MS in Engineering) program. All undergraduate programs are accredited by ABET. SET presently has 24 full-time faculty members. Courses are taught in an attractive 70,000 square foot engineering & technology building which houses more than twenty laboratories and support spaces.

About CMU

Central Michigan University has a more than 125-year legacy of preparing students to become leaders and changemakers in their communities and in their personal and professional lives.

We serve nearly 15,500 students on our Mount Pleasant campus, in satellite locations around the state and throughout the country, and through flexible online programs. Many of our approximately 300 undergraduate, master's, specialist and doctoral programs in the arts, media, business, education, human services, health professions, liberal arts, social sciences, medicine, science and engineering are nationally ranked for excellence.

CMU leads the nation in leadership development programming through our Sarah R. Opperman Leadership Institute, and we are proud to be among only 5% of U.S. universities in the top two Carnegie research classifications. Our faculty work with graduate and undergraduate students in areas such as Great Lakes research, medical innovation, engineering technology and more.

Central is home to 17 men's and women's Division 1 sports including football, basketball, gymnastics, baseball, wrestling and more. Support development of presentation materials and visual information on data management progress and outcomes. III. AUTHORITY A. Manesar, Haryana

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on Design Engineer to join our core engineering team and drive the design, development, testing, and optimization of next-generation drone and UAV systems.

The ideal candidate is a practical, field-tested engineer with strong expertise in mechanical design, UAV structures, aerodynamics, CFD, materials, and manufacturing
- someone who has independently taken UAV components or complete systems from concept through CAD, analysis, prototyping, manufacturing, testing, and real-world field deployment
, not just theoretical or simulation work.

Key Responsibilities

UAV & Mechanical Design

• Independently design UAV/drone airframes, structural components, and mechanical sub-assemblies.
• Develop production-ready 3D models and 2D engineering drawings (SolidWorks, Fusion 360, AutoCAD, or equivalent).
• Own designs end-to-end — from concept through prototyping, manufacturing, and field deployment.
• Balance weight, strength, stability, durability, and manufacturability in every design decision.
• Partner with electronics, flight-control, and systems teams on integration and weight distribution.
• Reverse engineering capabilities to scan a model and prepare the design with required modification.
Aerodynamics & CFD

• Apply practical aerodynamics and fluid mechanics knowledge to real UAV flight scenarios.
• Run CFD simulations (ANSYS Fluent/CFX or equivalent) to optimize lift, drag, stability, and efficiency.
• Translate simulation results into concrete design changes.
• Diagnose and resolve aerodynamic issues that surface during actual flight testing, not just on paper.
Manufacturing & Materials

• Select materials (carbon-fiber composites, high-strength polymers, lightweight alloys, aerospace-grade materials) based on strength, weight, cost, and durability requirements.
• Apply design-for-manufacturing (DFM) principles to keep designs production-ready and repeatable.
• Coordinate with fabrication teams on CNC machining, 3D printing, and composite molding. Testing & Field Validation

• Validate designs through prototyping, ground testing, and flight testing.
• Use field feedback and test data to drive continuous design iteration.
• Demonstrate a track record of designs that are personally developed and currently operating in the field - not shelved prototypes.
Documentation & Compliance

• Produce detailed engineering drawings, specifications, and BOMs.
• Ensure designs meet applicable engineering, safety, and regulatory standards.
• Maintain configuration control and documentation throughout the product lifecycle.
Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work closely with flight-control, electronics, manufacturing, and operations teams to resolve design and performance issues.
• Support fast design iteration cycles based on test data and operational needs.

Required Qualifications & Skills

• Education Bachelor's or Master's degree in Aerospace, Aeronautical, Mechanical, or Mechanical Design Engineering, or a related field.
• Proven, independent ownership of UAV/drone mechanical and structural designs — not just design support.
• Demonstrable experience with UAV components or systems that have been manufactured, tested, and deployed in the field.
• Strong practical grounding in aerodynamics, fluid mechanics, and UAV structural design.
• Proficiency in SolidWorks, Fusion 360, AutoCAD, or equivalent CAD tools.
• Hands-on CFD analysis experience using ANSYS Fluent/CFX or equivalent.
• Working knowledge of composite materials, lightweight structures, CNC machining, and additive manufacturing.
• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to turn theory into flight ready hardware.

Preferred

• FEA/structural and multi-physics simulation experience.
• Experience with fixed-wing UAVs, multirotors, VTOL, or other autonomous aircraft.
• Direct experience working with manufacturing/fabrication teams and running flight tests.
• Background in aerospace, defence, aviation, drone, or robotics industries.
• Strong technical communication skills.

Ideal Candidate

Someone who can point to a real design lifecycle they've owned: Design → Analysis → Manufacturing → Testing → Field Deployment.

Manesar, Haryana

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on Design Engineer to join our core engineering team and drive the design, development, testing, and optimization of next-generation drone and UAV systems.

The ideal candidate is a practical, field-tested engineer with strong expertise in mechanical design, UAV structures, aerodynamics, CFD, materials, and manufacturing
- someone who has independently taken UAV components or complete systems from concept through CAD, analysis, prototyping, manufacturing, testing, and real-world field deployment
, not just theoretical or simulation work.

Key Responsibilities

UAV & Mechanical Design

• Independently design UAV/drone airframes, structural components, and mechanical sub-assemblies.
• Develop production-ready 3D models and 2D engineering drawings (SolidWorks, Fusion 360, AutoCAD, or equivalent).
• Own designs end-to-end — from concept through prototyping, manufacturing, and field deployment.
• Balance weight, strength, stability, durability, and manufacturability in every design decision.
• Partner with electronics, flight-control, and systems teams on integration and weight distribution.
• Reverse engineering capabilities to scan a model and prepare the design with required modification.
Aerodynamics & CFD

• Apply practical aerodynamics and fluid mechanics knowledge to real UAV flight scenarios.
• Run CFD simulations (ANSYS Fluent/CFX or equivalent) to optimize lift, drag, stability, and efficiency.
• Translate simulation results into concrete design changes.
• Diagnose and resolve aerodynamic issues that surface during actual flight testing, not just on paper.
Manufacturing & Materials

• Select materials (carbon-fiber composites, high-strength polymers, lightweight alloys, aerospace-grade materials) based on strength, weight, cost, and durability requirements.
• Apply design-for-manufacturing (DFM) principles to keep designs production-ready and repeatable.
• Coordinate with fabrication teams on CNC machining, 3D printing, and composite molding. Testing & Field Validation

• Validate designs through prototyping, ground testing, and flight testing.
• Use field feedback and test data to drive continuous design iteration.
• Demonstrate a track record of designs that are personally developed and currently operating in the field - not shelved prototypes.
Documentation & Compliance

• Produce detailed engineering drawings, specifications, and BOMs.
• Ensure designs meet applicable engineering, safety, and regulatory standards.
• Maintain configuration control and documentation throughout the product lifecycle.
Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work closely with flight-control, electronics, manufacturing, and operations teams to resolve design and performance issues.
• Support fast design iteration cycles based on test data and operational needs.

Required Qualifications & Skills

• Education Bachelor's or Master's degree in Aerospace, Aeronautical, Mechanical, or Mechanical Design Engineering, or a related field.
• Proven, independent ownership of UAV/drone mechanical and structural designs — not just design support.
• Demonstrable experience with UAV components or systems that have been manufactured, tested, and deployed in the field.
• Strong practical grounding in aerodynamics, fluid mechanics, and UAV structural design.
• Proficiency in SolidWorks, Fusion 360, AutoCAD, or equivalent CAD tools.
• Hands-on CFD analysis experience using ANSYS Fluent/CFX or equivalent.
• Working knowledge of composite materials, lightweight structures, CNC machining, and additive manufacturing.
• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to turn theory into flight ready hardware.

Preferred

• FEA/structural and multi-physics simulation experience.
• Experience with fixed-wing UAVs, multirotors, VTOL, or other autonomous aircraft.
• Direct experience working with manufacturing/fabrication teams and running flight tests.
• Background in aerospace, defence, aviation, drone, or robotics industries.
• Strong technical communication skills.

Ideal Candidate

Someone who can point to a real design lifecycle they've owned: Design → Analysis → Manufacturing → Testing → Field Deployment.
